then.text: Back again? You'll be wanting the tour. Juniper, coriander, orris root, a bit of citrus. And soft Dartmoor water, that's the secret.

else.text: The Mayflower? Ah. The story goes that the Pilgrims spent their last night in England right here, in this building. It's been told for a very long time.
Is it true? The building was certainly here in 1620; parts of it go back to the 1400s. And where else would you go on your last night, but somewhere warm?
There's the ship on our label, too. Go on, the Old Salt on the quay will tell you the rest.
{greeting} Gin's been made here since 1793. The Navy took it on every ship, in a stronger version: Navy Strength.
The old tale is that if the spirit spilled on the gunpowder, the powder would still light at that strength. Nobody tests that any more, for some reason.
